units.source_text: 不過，面對家人與外人，身在故鄉與他鄉，因人與場所的不同，都難免會存在演技上的難度差異。

en.t: However, whether facing family or outsiders, whether in one's hometown or in a foreign place, differences in people and setting inevitably make the difficulty of acting vary.

units.source_text: 即使對於蓋世天才，包括上帝之子的耶穌在內，這種難度上的差異也在所難免。

en.t: Even for peerless geniuses, including Jesus, the Son of God, such differences in difficulty are unavoidable.

units.source_text: 對於演員而言，最難施展演技的場所莫過於自己的故鄉劇場，

en.t: For an actor, the hardest place to display his craft is surely the theater of his own hometown,

units.source_text: 尤其是在所有的親戚集聚一堂的情況下，

en.t: especially when all of his relatives are gathered together in one place,

units.source_text: 哪怕是再有名的演員，想必也很難發揮自己的演技吧。

en.t: even the most famous actor would probably find it hard to exercise his talent.

units.source_text: 我卻一路表演下來，而且取得了很大成功。

en.t: Yet I kept on performing throughout, and achieved considerable success.

units.source_text: 所以像我這樣的老江湖，在他鄉表演，自然是萬無一失的。

en.t: So for an old hand like me, performing away from home was naturally something that could not possibly go wrong.
